content: In the following, we first present a state-of-the art of data-to-text literature (Section 2), and then describe our proposed hierarchical data encoder (Section 3). The evaluation protocol is presented in Section 4, followed by the results (Section 5). Section 6 concludes the paper and presents perspectives.
